data.description: Defective item - scratches on Anabella Nighstand
data.content:
* * *

## [Defective item - scratches on Anabella Nighstand](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/64a5fb22706f837cb10be8b3)
I ordered 2 of the Anabella Nightstand ($698 each) and both arrived today. My star rating is for one of the items received, it had 2 noticeable scratches right on the top and on the drawer. I don't understand why this was even dispatched from the warehouse from Quality Control, this was clearly a defective that should not have even been released. I am waiting for a response from the L&G team to get a new one sent immediately. Disappointed. (side note, delivery team was super late and did not arrive until way past committed timeframe)

June 28, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 6, 2023

Hi There,

Thank you for reaching out and we're sorry to hear your items arrived with issues. We will get a representative to further assist you with this. If you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to support@luluandgeorgia.com.
